name: betterleaks-incremental-transactional-report-8c49
instr:
Betterleaks cannot produce reports incrementally with bounded memory and transactional publication while preserving existing report representations and command outcomes. Keep batch reporting compatible.

Build sequential report sessions that accept ordered, eligible findings until commit, abort, or failure. Afterward, reject use with `ErrReportSessionClosed`, exactly `errors.New("report session is closed")`. Report truthful accepted, written, and buffered counts. Copy, filter, redact, and serialize mixed-status detector output once in delivery order without mutating verbose or retained consumers.

Publish file reports atomically after successful finalization. Aborts and encoder or destination errors must preserve prior targets and return the originating error unchanged. Failed scans with findings publish valid partial reports without exposing intermediate bytes.

Keep JSON, CSV, JUnit, SARIF, and template output structurally valid when empty or populated. Preserve batch representations, format metadata, schemas, payloads, and safety behavior. `ReportStats.Buffered` stays zero regardless of scan size for JSON, CSV, JUnit, and SARIF. Template sessions report accepted findings buffered until commit.

Preserve explicit and inferred formats, templates, stdout behavior, summaries, finding counts, scan-based exits, legacy batch writes, partial redaction, verbose printing, and independent finding copies. SARIF keeps a stable ordered rule catalog and complete result data. CLI-selected
